title: Wave 2 theme queue
description: Queue state of the night wave, on disk so a dead orchestrator window is resumed from the file instead of from memory. One row per theme; the orchestrator holds nothing else about a theme in its own context.

concurrency.description: Hard cap on theme agents alive at once. 2 — the machine holds two building processes (16 GB, next build + medusa develop + Playwright at 1-2 GB each). A third would queue on hardware anyway.

mode.description: The mode the theme is DESIGNED around. null = the theme agent decides and writes it back.

why.description: Why this theme sits at this place in the order.

stage.description: Last stage the theme reached: W1 board, W2 catalog, W3 images, W5 copy, W6 assembly, W8 visual gate.

handoverPath.description: Repo-relative path of the theme's own report. The orchestrator references it and never reads it whole.

costUsd.description: Dollars actually spent on this theme, summed from spend.json. null means NOT MEASURED — the pilot wrote 0 for that and it must not happen twice.

tokens.description: Agent token cost; the pilot never recorded it for five of seven agents.

reason.description: Required when state is skipped or blocked.
